notes: Hand-counted by inspecting clean frames of the source video (Claude, 2026-09-19). Rule: count every person whose head or upper body is clearly visible, including staff behind the counter, people partly cut off by the frame edge, and small children; ignore fragments that are too small or occluded to call. Crowded top-of-frame areas are ambiguous, so each count is realistically +/-2. This is a manual estimate, not exhaustive annotation.
